2. Summarize the incident
3. Do not add causes (this is important - the task says "Do not add causes" and mentions "The cause remains under investigation" as part of the source text, but the instruction says not to add causes)

The colon suggests the text after is the incident to summarize. The instruction "Do not add causes" means I shouldn't invent causes for the incident. The source text mentions "The cause remains under investigation" which is a statement about the cause, not a cause itself.
